definitions.full: H6084. Ophrah עָפְרָה proper name 1. location: a. in Benjamin Josh 18:23 (P), Αφαρ , etc.; 1Sam 13:7 Γοφερα ; probably = עֶפְרוֺן 2 and אֶפְרַיִם 6 ; perhaps modern e‰-ˆayyibeh , approximately 4 miles northeast from Bethel, compare GASm Geogr. 252 Buhl Geogr. 177. b. in Manasseh , Εφραθα : Judg 6:11 ; 8:27 ; construct הָעֶזְרִי אֲבִי עָפְרַת 6:24 , but וגו ׳עָפְרָה 8:32 ; with ה locative עָפְרָ֫תָה 9:5 . 2. person, masculine in Judah 1Chr 4:14 , Γοφερα , ᵐ5 L Εφραθ .
